verdict.rationale: Orama's docs describe a dedicated bulk API, `insertMultiple`. It is recommended for large numbers of records because inserting in a loop can block the event loop, so batch ingestion across many documents is clearly supported. The evidence only covers bulk insertion, though; it says nothing about bulk update, remove, or other batch mutations, or about exposing batch actions to AI or agent workflows. Missing for 10: bulk update/delete operations, batch actions via Cloud/MCP for agents, independent or hands-on corroboration.
